widget.name: Modern Pie Chart
widget.description: Modern Pie Chart with generate reports and opitons

property.caption: Data Source
property.description: Select list data source

property.caption: Label
property.description: Slice label attribute

property.caption: Json
property.description: Json attribute for detailed data

property.caption: Value
property.description: Slice value attribute

property.caption: Slice Color (optional)
property.description: Optional per-slice hex color attribute. Leave empty to use the chart theme palette.

property.caption: Chart Title
property.description: Chart title displayed above the chart

property.caption: Container Class
property.description: Custom CSS class for chart container

property.caption: Chart Height (px)
property.description: Height of chart in pixels

property.caption: Chart Theme
property.description: Select a predefined color theme for the chart. Choose 'Custom' to use the Start Color and End Color properties.

property.caption: Start Color
property.description: Base color used to generate the slice palette in themed mode, or the first slice color in Custom mode

property.caption: End Color
property.description: End color used to generate the slice palette gradient in Custom mode

property.caption: Donut Mode
property.description: Render as a donut instead of a full pie

property.caption: Donut Cutout %
property.description: Only applies when Donut Mode is enabled (recommended 50-70)

property.caption: Show Slice Labels
property.description: Display label and percentage on or near each slice

property.caption: Legend Position
property.description: Position of the chart legend

property.caption: Label Max Length
property.description: Maximum legend label length before truncation (recommended 15)

property.caption: Modal Theme
property.description: Auto follows the chart's light/dark mode. Light or Dark forces the modal theme.

property.caption: Modal Width
property.description: Optional. Any CSS width, e.g. 90%, 1000px, 70vw. Empty = 90% (max 1200px).

property.caption: Modal Height
property.description: Optional. Any CSS height, e.g. 85vh, 600px. Empty = 85vh.

property.caption: Border Radius
property.description: Optional. Corner radius in px (a plain number) or any CSS length. Empty = 8.

property.caption: Font Size
property.description: Optional. Table font size in px (a plain number) or any CSS length. Empty = 14px.

property.caption: Background Color
property.description: Modal and table body background. Any CSS color. Empty = theme default.

property.caption: Text Color
property.description: Body text color. Empty = theme default.

property.caption: Border Color
property.description: Color of table and header borders. Empty = theme default.

property.caption: Header Background
property.description: Background of the modal title bar. Empty = transparent.

property.caption: Header Text Color
property.description: Color of the modal title and close button. Empty = theme default.

property.caption: Table Header Background
property.description: Background of the table's column header row (including the filter inputs). Empty = theme default.

property.caption: Table Header Text Color
property.description: Text color of the column headers. Empty = theme default.

property.caption: Striped Row Color
property.description: Background of every second row (when Striped Rows is on). Empty = theme default.

property.caption: Row Hover Color
property.description: Row highlight color on hover. Empty = theme default.

property.caption: Accent Color
property.description: Optional. Color of the Export button and focused inputs. Empty = follows the Chart Theme (Start Color in Custom mode).

property.caption: Striped Rows
property.description: Alternate row shading in the table.

property.caption: Column Filters
property.description: Show a filter input under each column header. Filters combine (AND) with each other and with the global search.

property.caption: Show Global Search
property.description: Show the search box that searches across all columns.

property.caption: Show Excel Export
property.description: Show the Export Excel button. The export contains the currently filtered rows.

property.caption: Backdrop Opacity
property.description: Optional. Darkness of the page behind the modal, from 0 (none) to 1 (black). Empty = 0.55 (light) / 0.7 (dark).

property.caption: Modal Class
property.description: Extra CSS class added to the modal overlay, for theme-level overrides.

property.caption: Enable Report
property.description: Enable report generation.

property.caption: Report Title
property.description: Title displayed in the generated report.

property.caption: Company Name
property.description: Company name shown in the report.

property.caption: Generated By
property.description: Name of the report generator.

property.caption: Footer Text
property.description: Footer displayed in the report.

property.caption: Export Button Text
property.description: Caption shown on the export button.

property.caption: Include Chart
property.description: Include the chart image in the report.

property.caption: Include Statistics
property.description: Include calculated statistics in the report.

property.caption: Include Data Table
property.description: Include the data table in the report.

property.caption: Generate Report Action
property.description: Microflow executed after report generation.

property.caption: Company Logo Path
property.description: Relative path to the company logo.

property.caption: Report Theme
property.description: Visual theme applied to the generated report

property.caption: Primary Color
property.description: Primary color used in the report theme

property.caption: Secondary Color
property.description: Secondary color used in the report theme
